patch_description: This crossover retains the regularized shared RY parameters and efficient disjoint CZ interaction schedule from the stronger inspiration program, while adding the useful post-entanglement RY basis layer associated with improved validation accuracy. The second independent RZ layer is omitted to reduce depth and parameter count. The resulting block uses 21 unique parameters per repetition, fewer than both the current program and the highest-scoring prior design, while preserving full graph connectivity and additional output-basis expressivity.
